ProgressSweeper is an analytic math puzzle for professional players. Your objective is to open correct cells and get blue segments avoiding yellow and red ones
Start by tapping the top left cell. It is always empty and safe
The cell was empty. That means that all cells around are safe as well. Now tap the second one
Great! You've found a blue segment and got some procents! Now tap a cell nearby
As you can see: there a number ONE. That means that we have ONE bad segment nearby. Let's try to find it
The numbers are yellow, that means that the bad segment we are looking for is yellow. Let's continue
There are numbers around red or yellow segments! Red segments have red numbers.
Now we have enough clues. We don't want to get a yellow one. Let's flag it
You've select a yellow flag. Now tap the cell
Superb! Each flag placed correctly will give you some extra point. Now continue the game
